from pathlib import Path
p=Path('/home/USER/continual-arc-baselines/.workbench/stage1/HPL-prime-agent-luna6-low-ws0/frozen/held-out-4/play/users/u020/system/state/workspace/programs/task-6b7de722.py')
p.parent.mkdir(parents=True,exist_ok=True)
p.write_text('''def transform(grid):
    # Return the contiguous 3x3 arrangement containing the uniquely three-colored pattern.
    from collections import deque
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    seen = set()
    comps = []
    for r in range(h):
        for c in range(w):
            if grid[r][c] == 0 or (r,c) in seen:
                continue
            q = deque([(r,c)]); seen.add((r,c)); cells=[]
            while q:
                y,x=q.popleft(); cells.append((y,x))
                for dy,dx in ((1,0),(-1,0),(0,1),(0,-1)):
                    z=(y+dy,x+dx)
                    if 0<=z[0]<h and 0<=z[1]<w and z not in seen and grid[z[0]][z[1]] != 0:
                        seen.add(z); q.append(z)
            comps.append(cells)
    # The target pattern is the 3x3 nonzero bounding box with three colors.
    for cells in comps:
        rs=[r for r,c in cells]; cs=[c for r,c in cells]
        if max(rs)-min(rs)==2 and max(cs)-min(cs)==2:
            out=[row[min(cs):max(cs)+1] for row in grid[min(rs):max(rs)+1]]
            if len({v for row in out for v in row})==3:
                return out
    raise ValueError('No unique three-color 3x3 pattern')
''')
